status_note: Declared screening benchmarks for the Talaix loss-screening ESTIMATE function (docs/ECONOMIC_INTELLIGENCE.md §9). Every value is a declared range with a stated basis — these are NOT valuations and NOT calibrated model parameters. The bands reflect the ~2023 price context (price_basis_year) and are dated at query time by the official Eurostat construction-cost index (STS_COPI_A) — the index scales all bands equally, it never narrows them. Floor-area assumptions are replaced by real cadastral means where a cadastre is integrated (docs/LOSS_DATA_ACQUISITION.md §2).

unit_conventions.replacement_cost_per_m2: EUR per m2 of building floor area (2025 price context, declared screening range)
unit_conventions.floor_area_per_building_m2: m2 of floor area per mapped OSM building (declared assumption — OSM building counts carry no floor areas)

replacement_cost_per_m2.basis: Published European residential reconstruction-cost ranges (Eurostat construction-cost index context and insurance valuation practice); generic screening range used when no country benchmark matches.

floor_area_per_building_m2.basis: Declared assumption for a generic mapped building (mix of dwellings, outbuildings and small commercial units). The range is deliberately wide — the estimate reports its own sensitivity instead of pretending precision.

replacement_cost_per_m2.basis: Luxembourg construction costs rank among the highest in the EU (Eurostat construction-cost context; national statistical publications); declared screening range.
